products.name: Palantir AIP
products.note: Enterprise AI platform; Ontology-based governance; defense/intel focus; high-stakes decision influence

profile_text.body:
Palantir is a publicly traded software company (NASDAQ: PLTR, CIK 0001321655) that, according to its own website, builds software intended to help organizations integrate their data, decisions, and operations. The company describes its offering with the phrase "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today."

Palantir's tracked AI product is Palantir AIP, an enterprise AI platform categorized under Data and Analytics AI. The platform is noted for Ontology-based governance, a focus on defense and intelligence use cases, and influence over high-stakes decision-making processes.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are held for Palantir in the site's current records.
